Thanks for taking this on. Acme is in the final stretch for our vendor review and the SIG indicates we need concrete artifacts for a handful of items. Can you confirm if you can provide the following by EOD Wednesday (PST)?

1) Data retention policy (PDF)
2) Production app network diagram showing subnets and guardrails (PNG/PDF)
3) Example runbook for incident escalation (markdown or PDF)
4) AppSec screenshots showing auth flow and role mappings (screenshots / redacted)
5) Evidence of SOC 2 control owners (names + org chart snippet)

We prefer Drive links with viewer access and a brief README in the folder describing redaction status. If there are any items you cannot share, please call out why (sensitive IPs, third-party licenses) and propose an alternative.

Also include a contact for any access issues (we'll be auditing link ACLs).

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this sits on the procurement path for our pilot.
